'''Toomey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Paklan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Toomey was present outside a diner with a band of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to assist him in capturing [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who took refuge on the planet. After sending a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] negotiator to use his pheromones on them, Toomey was shocked after the Falleen was brutally killed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. After paying [[Zika]] his payment, he led the bounty hunters inside the diner and ordered the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] to surrender until they were all killed by Savage.
